name: @lonely-lights/alexandria-core
description: Type-only peer-dep manifest for the alexandria-core resources/js tree. This package is NOT published to npm — consumer apps install these as their own deps and reach core's TS files via the @alexandria/* path alias (see docs/integration/frontend-setup.md). The devDependencies block exists only so PHPStorm and tsc can resolve types when working inside the core repo directly.
